solids.name: Upper nip roller

solids.name: Nip coupling belt

massKg.note: 1.8 lb, the upper bound the iteration 002 evaluation used; 1.5 lb is a guess for a light pipe

stiffnessNPerM.note: Polycarbonate or UHMW-faced panel on its supports, about 0.3 mm under the pipe at 8 g: an estimate

friction.note: UHMW tape on the floor; the recorded campaign swept 0.15 and 0.35

stiffnessNPerM.note: Per roller at the 6 mm squeeze; no supplier publishes it. Bench gate G0 sets the wheels to 40-120 N/mm

restitution.note: 35A compliant wheel: an estimate; the recorded custody trials swept 0.1 and 0.7

friction.note: Compliant tread on PVC; the recorded campaign swept 0.3 to 1.0

ohm.measured: REV-21-1651 data sheet: 12 V stall current

keVsPerRad.measured: REV-21-1651 data sheet: 11000 rpm free at 12 V

efficiency.note: MAXPlanetary 4:1 x 3:1 x 3:1 at 0.9 per stage, assumed

inertiaKgM2.note: NEO 550 rotor (1.5e-6 kg m2, unsourced estimate) times 36 squared, plus both shafts and eight wheels (8e-5)

nip squeeze.note: Slotted bearing blocks on both side plates move each roller 1 mm per step toward or away from the pipe centreline

flap preload.note: Torsion-spring wind-up on the flap pin, set by the leg's notch

eject voltage.note: Open-loop eject voltage in software, with voltage compensation
